headline_summary: 全球处于“能源通胀重定价+AI举债去杠杆+避险买长债与黄金”混合状态：美9月CPI/PPI超预期但核心零售停滞，台积电/ASML暴赚难阻芯片抛售；中国PTA/长丝链与大盘价值相对优势居全球前三。

key_divergences: US September headline CPI (+0.6% MoM) and PPI (+1.3% MoM) surged on energy, but real Retail Control Group fell -0.1% MoM, driving 30Y Treasury yields down 13 bps to 5.39% (bull flattening).
TSMC Q3 FCF surged +65.8% QoQ to NT$476.56B and ASML Q3 net sales hit a record €11.66B, yet SOXX fell -8.62% over 5 days as CoreWeave bond yields hit 14.9% and Kospi plunged -7.6%.
China September PPI jumped +5.0% YoY while core CPI stayed at +1.0% YoY and 30Y CGB yield broke below 2.06%; SSE 50 (-0.42% 1D, 5D RV 9.37%) vastly outperformed CSI 1000 (-3.28% 1D, 5D RV 29.83%).

A-share Q3 announcements showed sharp single-quarter QoQ divergence: Tongkun Group (+6% to +23% QoQ) and Guangku Tech (+26% to +48% QoQ) expanded, while Longsys (-35% to -49% QoQ) and Zhongjin Gold (-26% to -41% QoQ) contracted despite high YTD YoY growth.

sources.title: Consumer Price Index Summary - September 2026 Results (U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics)
supported_claims: US September 2026 CPI-U rose 0.6% MoM SA and 3.7% YoY NSA (up from 3.4% in August).
Gasoline rose 9.1% MoM (34.2% YoY) and energy rose 5.2% MoM (20.4% YoY), accounting for over half of the monthly headline increase.
Core CPI (all items less food and energy) rose 0.3% MoM SA and 2.6% YoY, with shelter up 0.4% MoM (3.2% YoY).

sources.title: Retail Sales, September 2026: The Pump Did the Work (U.S. Census Bureau / Piedmont Crescent Capital)
supported_claims: US September 2026 headline retail and food services sales rose 0.8% MoM to $745.0B (+6.3% YoY), beating the 0.3% consensus.
Gasoline stations (+6.4% MoM) contributed 0.55 percentage points (~70%) of the headline gain.
Retail control group rose only 0.1% MoM (vs 0.3% consensus), and real core retail spending fell 0.1% MoM when deflated by core goods CPI (+0.3% MoM).
